profile.name: CPU片上温度传感器
profile.description: 集成在处理器芯片内部的温度传感器，用于读取CPU热区温度。在实验室和计算平台中可用于热管理、过温告警、散热评估，以及负载测试过程中的温升监测。
profile.description_en: An integrated temperature sensor inside the processor used to read the CPU thermal-zone temperature. In laboratory and computing setups, it is used for thermal management, over-temperature alarms, cooling evaluation, and temperature-rise monitoring during load testing.

registry.name: Cpu Temperature
registry.description: Cpu Temperature驱动，支持temperature/value/is active/closed/event delay等13个操作。
